title.zh: 一段程序是怎么跑起来的？

brief.zh: 给芽芽补 3 格电。一步步跟着数字走，看看它存在哪里、交给了谁、最后怎样回到屏幕。
brief.en: Give Sprout 3 more units of charge. Follow the number step by step to see where it is stored, who gets it, and how it ends up on the display.

concept.en: Variables, functions, and the call stack

execution.source:
def add_charge(current, extra):
    total = current + extra
    return total

def prepare_robot(current):
    extra = 3
    ready = add_charge(current, extra)
    return ready

charge = scan()
result = prepare_robot(charge)
say(str(result))

note.zh: 从电池读出还有几格，把这个数记下来。
note.en: Read how many units are left in the battery and write that number down.

note.zh: 把刚记下的电量交给小帮手，等它把算好的新电量交回来。
note.en: Give the helper the number you read. Wait for it to send back the new charge.

note.zh: 小帮手交回数字后，芽芽才能把它显示在屏幕上。
note.en: Once the helper returns the number, Sprout can show it on the screen.

note.zh: 把下面两步收在一个图框里，有人来请时就按框里的顺序做。
note.en: Keep the next two actions in one box. The helper follows them in order when called.

note.zh: 把传来的旧电量和要补的格数加在一起，记下总数。
note.en: Add the old charge and the amount to top up. Write down the total.

note.zh: 把总数交给正在等的补电小帮手。
note.en: Hand the total back to the waiting charging helper.

note.zh: 下面三步是一套做法，芽芽请小帮手时才会开始。
note.en: The next three actions go together. They start when Sprout calls the charging helper.

note.zh: 小帮手有自己的记事格，在里面写下 3。
note.en: The helper has its own note. It writes the number 3 there.

note.zh: 把旧电量和新加的 3 格交给加法小帮手，再等它交回总数。
note.en: Give the adding helper the old charge and the 3 extra units. Wait for it to send back the total.

label.en: Send the new charge to Sprout

note.zh: 拿到总数后，补电小帮手把它交回芽芽。
note.en: Once the charging helper receives the total, it sends it back to Sprout.

title.zh: 主程序依次读取、计算和显示
title.en: The main program reads, calculates, and displays in order

body.zh: charge = scan() 先读起始电量，prepare_robot(charge) 接着计算新电量，say(str(result)) 最后让芽芽显示结果。屏幕要等计算完成，才有数字可显示。
body.en: charge = scan() reads the starting charge. prepare_robot(charge) works out the new charge. Finally, say(str(result)) tells Sprout to display it. The display needs the answer from the calculation.

title.zh: 变量像贴了名字的记事格
title.en: A variable is like a named note

body.zh: 读到的数字放进 charge，算好的数字放进 result。等 result 里有了数字，芽芽才能把它显示出来。换一个起始电量，再看看这两个格子。
body.en: The starting number goes into charge. The answer goes into result. Sprout can show the answer once result holds a number. Try a different starting charge and look at both notes again.

title.zh: 函数把小帮手的动作装在一起
title.en: A function groups the helper’s actions

body.zh: def 下方缩进的几条指令，是补电小帮手自己的步骤。运行 prepare_robot(charge) 会启动这组步骤，把起始电量交给小帮手。它在自己的记事格 current 里使用这个数。
body.en: The instructions indented under def are the charging helper’s own steps. Running prepare_robot(charge) starts those steps and hands the starting charge to the helper, which uses the number in its own note named current.

title.zh: 调用堆栈记住谁在等结果
title.en: The call stack remembers who is waiting

body.zh: 芽芽请补电小帮手，补电小帮手又请加法小帮手。每请一位帮手，堆栈就多一层。最上层用 return 把数交回去后，下面等着的那层才能接着做。
body.en: Sprout calls the charging helper, which calls the adding helper. Each call adds a layer to the stack. When the top layer sends the number back with return, the layer waiting below can carry on.

prompt.zh: 加法小帮手执行 return total 后，谁先接到这个数字？
prompt.en: Who gets the number first when the adding helper runs return total?

options.zh: 补电小帮手接到数字，记在 ready 里。
options.en: The charging helper gets the number and stores it in ready.

options.zh: 加法小帮手从第一行重新开始。
options.en: The adding helper starts again from the first line.

options.zh: 芽芽的屏幕直接接到这个数字。
options.en: Sprout’s screen gets the number straight away.

feedback.zh: 数字先回到等它的补电小帮手。补电小帮手把数记下来，再交给芽芽。
feedback.en: The number goes back to the charging helper that was waiting. The charging helper stores it, then hands it back to Sprout.

caption.zh: 芽芽读到电池还有 6 格，把数字记下来。
caption.en: Sprout reads 6 units from the battery and writes down the number.

caption.zh: 芽芽把 6 交给补电小帮手，自己先等着。
caption.en: Sprout hands 6 to the charging helper and waits.

caption.zh: 补电小帮手也在等结果。最上面的加法小帮手算出了 9。
caption.en: The charging helper waits too. The adding helper on top works out 9.

caption.zh: 加法小帮手交回 9，补电小帮手接着做。
caption.en: The adding helper hands back 9, and the charging helper carries on.

caption.zh: 补电小帮手把 9 交给芽芽。芽芽在屏幕上显示新电量。
caption.en: The charging helper hands 9 to Sprout, who shows the new charge on the screen.
